title: Remove Blocking Git Hooks
description: Replace husky with a global pre-commit setup for the monorepo.
summary: Removed all blocking git hooks. Added removeGitHooks to repo CLI configure command (clears pre-commit, post-commit, and related hook files). Deleted .pre-commit-config.yaml and pre-commit dev dependency. Updated setup git messaging and README. Extended configure test to verify hook removal. Removed local post-commit hook.
